summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 Management Discussion and Analysis, interim financial statements, and CEO/CFO certifications for the period ended September 30, 2026. No transaction is announced. Disclosed items include attributable gold production of 186,900 ounces in the quarter and 558,600 ounces year-to-date, 2026 guidance of 720,000 to 820,000 ounces, quarterly revenues of $856.5 million from 199,900 ounces sold at an average realized price of $4,277 per ounce, and reference to a share buyback program. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated.
